_comment: Project-wide Claude Code settings for the user-search worked example. Tracked. Per-user overrides go in .claude/settings.local.json (gitignored).

permissions._comment: Conservative defaults. Allow read-only inspection and basic git introspection without prompting.

_env_comment: Environment variables passed to tools. No secrets here - those go in .env (gitignored) or shell profile.
_mcp_comment: MCP servers for the Claude Code CLI live in .mcp.json at the repo root (project scope) or ~/.claude.json (user scope) - rename .claude/mcp.template.json into place. For the canonical inventory, regenerate from runtimes/mcp/servers.yaml in the SpecRoute repo.
_hooks_comment: Hooks MUST live here. Claude Code does not read a project-level .claude/hooks/hooks.json - that filename is a plugin hook source only. The annotated original lives at .claude/hooks/hooks.json; the "hooks" key below is generated from it by SpecRoute's tools/sync-hooks-to-settings.sh. Edit hooks.json, re-run the script, do not hand-edit "hooks" here.
